name: Manna
overview: Scripture reveals that manna was a miraculous provision from the LORD, given to the Israelites in the wilderness as bread from heaven to sustain them daily. God instructed Moses that the people were to gather a set portion each day, with a double portion on the sixth day to prepare for the Sabbath, demonstrating divine provision and testing their obedience. The daily appearance of manna, accompanied by the glory of the LORD, served as a tangible sign of God's faithfulness and His deliverance from Egypt, despite the people's murmuring and doubts.
